integrity: Self-contained exact analytic proof; exact rational all-edge-column checks on W(3,2) and W(3,3), 45+160 columns. Computational checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Endpoint norms of canonical Euclidean orthogonal cut and cycle projections on equal-order finite generalized-quadrangle incidence graphs only. The existence of the geometry is assumed. No claim about minimum over all projections, general p, arbitrary generalized-quadrangle parameters, or independent novelty certification.
title: Sharp endpoint cut–cycle projection norms of generalized-quadrangle incidence graphs
